entries.english: I can give you up to three hints.

entries.source_line: [04 07 00][05 08 00][05 09 00][05 0A 00]@Why do you keep insisting on talking to me?

entries.english: Please sing the melodies that you have learned to me.
entries.fr: Chante-moi les mélodies que tu connais.

entries.english: Happiness won't just walk into your life on its own.

entries.english: Did you come to stay another night?

entries.english: The Ocarina of Hope is finally complete.

Do you have anything else that you wish me to store?

entries.english: Great! I'm sure we'll make a great team of punks.
entries.fr: Super! On fera une sacrée équipe de voyous.

entries.english: Hey, you two there.
Hey, you can't drink that!
Now do you regret what you did?

entries.english: Brute strength is not enough to beat 'em.

entries.english: Did you hear about the weird things happening in Podunk?
entries.fr: As-tu entendu parler des choses étranges à Podunk?
entries.source_line: @Did you hear about the weird things happening in Podunk?

entries.english: Do you think the train tickets are too expensive?

entries.english: Have you used the Bullhorn?
entries.source_line: @Have you used the Bullhorn?

entries.english: Have you been to the Sweet Little Factory?

entries.english: You want to be my friend?

entries.english: Well, please take a look at the price list.

entries.english: Hello and thank you for calling the Hint Union!

entries.english: You sound like quite the musician.
